sources.note: Town of Alburgh official website, Selectboard page (read October 17, 2026): Alex McCracken, Jim Hokenberg, Russell Duchaine, Walter Kane, Tom Ward. The Secretary of State's selectboard directory publishes no Alburgh roster. Terms printed on the page are not recorded as membership dates.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact information spreadsheet (last updated June 12, 2026), Alburgh row: Danielle James Choiniere, Town Clerk.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers & County Clerks' (January 2026), Alburgh entry: Danielle James Choiniere, Clerk.
Town of Alburgh official website, Town Clerk page (read October 17, 2026): Town Clerk Danielle James Choiniere, elected on a three-year cycle.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers & County Clerks' (January 2026), Alburgh entry: Margret Brescia, Treasurer.

Town of Alburgh official website, Town Clerk page (read October 17, 2026): Town Treasurer Margret Brescia, appointed by the selectboard. The Secretary of State's treasurer spreadsheet publishes no Alburgh treasurer.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (last updated December 4, 2025), Alburgh (Grand Isle County): Christopher Higgins, Gina Lewis, Loretta Knight, Lisa Arnold, Constance Boutin, John Goodrich. The listing presents the justices elected November 5, 2024.
Town of Alburgh official website, Listers page (read October 17, 2026): Cheryl Dunn, Donna Boumil, and one seat shown as Vacancy.

Town of Alburgh official website, Auditors page (read October 17, 2026): Kristy Taylor (term 2024-2027), Alton Bruso (term 2026-2029), Joanne James (serving the remainder of a 2025-2028 term). Terms printed on the page are not recorded as membership dates.

Town of Alburgh official website, Auditors page (read October 17, 2026): Joanne James, serving 2026-2027 for the remaining term 2025-2028. The page does not state whether she was appointed or elected to the remainder; she is recorded as elected, the office's ordinary mode, with the uncertainty noted here and flagged on issue #163.

Town of Alburgh official website, Town Officers page (read October 17, 2026): Delinquent Tax Collector Danielle James Choiniere. The office is held separately from the Town Treasurer in Alburgh (17 V.S.A. section 2651d); the page does not state the mode of selection, and the holder is recorded as elected, the office's ordinary mode when a town fills it separately.

Office established for Vermont towns by 17 V.S.A. section 2646 (moderator, elected annually). No official source found as of 2026-10-17 publishes the current Alburgh holder; the post is created as structure only and the membership awaits the printed annual town report or a clerk records reply.
